Got it! I've saved all of that to memory so I'll always keep it in mind when planning your meals. Here's a quick summary of what I've noted about your family:

👨 **You** — Type 2 diabetic, so I'll focus on **low GI, low sugar, high-fibre** meals for you.

👩 **Wife** — Vegetarian, so **no meat or fish** in her dishes (or I'll suggest easy veggie swaps).

👧👧 **Twin Daughters** — Love **chicken and eggs** — great protein options for lunchboxes and dinners!

🍛🥢 **Cuisine Preferences** — **Indian and Chinese** — delicious and very adaptable for all your needs!

---

This is really helpful context. A few things I'll keep in mind going forward:

- **Indian & Chinese cuisine** are actually brilliant for your family — lots of naturally vegetarian Indian dishes (dals, paneer, sabzis) and veggie-friendly Chinese options (tofu stir-fries, egg fried rice).
- For **your diabetic needs**, I'll lean towards brown rice over white, whole wheat rotis, lots of veggies, and protein-rich meals.
- The **girls' chicken and egg love** makes lunchbox planning easy — think egg wraps, chicken skewers, and boiled eggs!

Whenever you're ready, just ask me to plan a weekly meal plan, build a shopping list, or sort out school lunchboxes — I've got your family covered! 😊
